name: cureMEC: The Myoepithelial Carcinoma Project
what: The patient-driven research project for this disease. Research, biospecimens and support.

name: Rare Cancer Research Foundation
what: Funds rare cancer research and runs tissue donation programs. A named collaborator of cureMEC.

name: NCI MyPART: Pediatric and Adult Rare Tumor Network
what: A U.S. National Cancer Institute network that studies rare tumors and sees patients.

name: National Organization for Rare Disorders (NORD)
what: Information, patient assistance programs and advocacy for rare diseases in the United States.

name: Genetic and Rare Diseases Information Center (GARD)
what: A U.S. National Institutes of Health information service on rare diseases.

name: Sarcoma Foundation of America
what: Research funding and patient resources for sarcoma. Soft-tissue myoepithelial carcinoma is treated at sarcoma centers.

name: Sarcoma UK
what: Information, a support line and research funding for sarcoma in the United Kingdom.

name: Salivary Gland Cancer UK
what: A charity for people with salivary gland cancers, including the rarer types.

name: Head and Neck Cancer Alliance
what: Support, education and advocacy for head and neck cancers in the United States.

name: National Cancer Institute: contact and information service
what: Cancer information specialists by phone, chat and email.

name: CancerCare
what: Free counseling, support groups and financial help from oncology social workers.

name: Triage Cancer
what: Help with insurance, employment and money after a cancer diagnosis.

name: Macmillan Cancer Support
what: Information, a support line and financial guidance in the United Kingdom.

name: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
what: Call or text 988 in the United States, at any hour.
